_about: Where each approved hand addition (rules/edits.json) sits in its pool's order when the template's own score would put it below 25 (Jorge, Nov 26, 2026: always inside the Top 25, where a fan would expect him). 1 = best. One the score already puts in the Top 25 keeps that place; an addition with no place here goes to the lowest free slot from 25. Also the place for a player the data undersells (ABA years). scripts/build-templates.mjs.
